performance.evidence: The e04 test plan defines no fixed latency, throughput, or project-size threshold.

reliability.evidence: Atomic owner decisions, stale/repeated adoption handling, append-only lifecycle history, readiness reassessment, and bounded review revision tests passed under Node.js 24.

operability.evidence: Decision packets, readiness causes and next actions, gate outcomes, dissent, and lifecycle events are inspectable through typed APIs and persisted records.

epic_scenarios.evidence: All 13 planned e04 scenarios are covered by the four story integration suites.

project_gates.evidence: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run build, npm test, preflight, blind-spot, and completeness checks passed after verification evidence was persisted.
